baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three occurrences of ح م ل at words 3, 7, and 10 move from passive assignment, through refused carrying, to the donkey's active carrying.
baseline_models.mechanism: One root stages two kinds of bearing. The people are commissioned with an entrusted burden but do not carry its right, while the donkey successfully transports a visible load. The animal does not represent no carrying; it exposes physical transport as a radically insufficient success.

activation_trace.role: Entrusted amanah or burden makes the passive assignment a commission whose right can be fulfilled or betrayed.
A visible load borne on an animal supplies the donkey's literal success and makes mere transport the failed substitute for fidelity.
The familiar donkey keeps the comparison materially literal while the repeated carrying root differentiates function from possession.

changed_reading.before: They had the Torah but failed to use it.
changed_reading.after: The ayah distinguishes imposed custody from enacted fidelity: the only carrying actually completed is donkey-level transport, so possession becomes evidence of an unfulfilled commission.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَسْفَارًا at word 11 stands beside denial of آيات at word 17.
baseline_models.mechanism: The books are not neutral cargo. Their lexical branch presents a book as something that uncovers what is written, and the ayat are visible signs. Treating such books as opaque mass reverses their disclosure function; denial is enacted by carrying the medium while blocking what it makes apparent.

activation_trace.role: The book that reveals writing makes disclosure, not weight, the cargo's intended function.
Removing a cover supplies the uncovering motion that inert carriage fails to perform.
A manifest sign names the content that should become visible through the revealing books.
Attributing falsity to the signs supplies the active blockage of the books' revealing function.

changed_reading.before: The donkey is ignorant of the contents of the books it carries.
changed_reading.after: The sharper failure is anti-disclosure: books whose work is to uncover signs have been converted into opaque weight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: القوم occurs twice, first with denial and then with ظلم, before the closing negation of guidance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The collective noun can resonate with standing over, preserving, and sustaining an affair. The group is therefore not only a demographic object of blame; it is a social body that fails to maintain the entrusted sign-system, withholds its due, and consequently lacks a directed way.

activation_trace.role: The human collective provides the social body in which the carrying failure becomes communal.
Guardianship and sustained care turn the qawm into would-be custodians of the entrusted text.
That which gives an affair support and order makes revelation a possible qiwam of collective life.
Gentle direction toward a path makes the closing non-guidance a loss of orientation, not a shortage of information.
Withholding a right casts the failure as preventing the entrusted signs from receiving their due in communal life.

changed_reading.before: A people is condemned for disbelief and therefore not guided.
changed_reading.after: A would-be stewarding community loses direction by refusing to make the entrusted signs the support and order of its shared life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ح م ل can hold both an exterior load and an interior pregnancy or fruit, while the simile insists on books remaining visibly outside the bearer.
baseline_models.mechanism: The donkey scene foregrounds exterior weight, but the root also carries an inward, fruit-bearing image. That branch permits a contrast between scripture borne on the outside and scripture allowed to mature into an interior product; the failure is that the entrusted load never becomes fruit.

activation_trace.role: Interior pregnancy and tree-fruit supply a generative kind of carrying that can mature into an outcome.
Exterior transport supplies the contrasting load that remains on the surface of its bearer.
The revealing book names what would have to enter and develop rather than remain bundled cargo.

changed_reading.before: The bearers fail to understand an external text.
changed_reading.after: The external load fails to become inwardly generative: revelation is carried but never brought to fruit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَثَل recurs three times and is explicitly judged by بِئْسَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The comparison becomes self-operative. It is a struck saying, an admonitory sign, and potentially a punitive exemplum: the depicted failure is made public so that the carriers themselves become a deterrent image for other hearers.

activation_trace.role: The struck proverb supplies the explicit comparison as a transmissible saying.
An example functioning as admonition or sign turns the simile into instruction for its present audience.
Punitive exemplarity makes the exposed group a warning by which others may be restrained.
The formal word of blame marks the example's deterrent evaluation rather than adding another neutral likeness.

changed_reading.before: The verse offers a vivid insulting comparison.
changed_reading.after: The failed carriers are made into an enduring warning-sign; the simile performs the very disclosure they refused to carry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier pedagogical chain defines successful transmission as recitation that follows, purification that grows, disclosure through teaching, and a book that joins elements into an ordered whole. This supplies positive operations missing from the focus scene and strengthens the distinction between entrusted performance and storage.

activation_trace.role: Entrusted burden remains the focus-side commission whose successful operation needs specification.
Following in sequence makes recitation a performed continuation, not merely voiced possession.
Growth and increase give reception an inwardly productive result.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the cognitive opening absent from inert carriage.
Joining one thing to another makes the Book an integrating order rather than a pile of separate pages.

structural_cues: 62:2 orders reciting signs, purifying, teaching the Book, and teaching wisdom as one linked sequence.
Its recipients move from manifest straying into this process, so the sequence is directional and transformative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered pedagogical verbs and their branch images; I infer that they specify what carrying the trust does to and through a recipient. A live alternative is that 62:2 only contrasts two audiences without defining ح م ل.

changed_reading.before: Carrying the Torah means observing or understanding what one possesses.
changed_reading.after: Carrying is a transmission process: follow the recited signs, undergo growth, receive disclosure, and integrate the Book into an ordered life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus locates books on an animal's back; the later context relocates moral carriage into what hands advance and what persons intentionally do. The entrusted text is successfully borne when it exits as deeds sent forward, while back-only bearing produces no accountable output.

activation_trace.role: The visible back-load supplies the static bodily location from which the context shifts agency.
Entrusted responsibility supplies the obligation that deeds must discharge.
Advancing something forward gives action a temporal destination beyond present possession.
What the hands earn transfers carrying from the back's load to the agent's produced record.
Intentional deed names the accountable output by which the entrusted burden becomes operative.

structural_cues: 62:7 explains the refusal of death through what hands have sent ahead.
62:8 closes the unavoidable return by saying they will be informed of what they used to do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies back-bearing in the focus and hands, advancement, and deeds in the context; I supply the transfer arrow from received text to produced action. The alternative is that the later deed-account is only consequence, not a definition of proper carrying.

changed_reading.before: The failure is failure to carry the text's meaning internally.
changed_reading.after: The diagnostic question is what the load makes the hands send ahead: scripture that produces no intentional deed remains on the back.

context_deltas.mechanism: The self-designation in 62:6 maps into the same directional branch family as the focus's يهدي, but it is surrounded by uncertain claiming, claimed exclusive stewardship, imagined wishing, and refusal of death. This makes the closing non-guidance a diagnosis of identity that names a way without actually taking its direction.

activation_trace.role: Direction, conduct, and intended course make guidance a lived orientation within the focus.
The context's mapped direction-and-conduct branch places the claimed communal designation beside the focus's unfulfilled orientation.
Speech without certainty qualifies exclusive status as a claim rather than demonstrated direction.
Taking charge and standing over an affair echoes the stewardship that the focus says was not carried.
A wish pictured by the heart supplies the demanded inner test of the outward claim.
Loss of life supplies the terminal destination that the claimed direction must be willing to face.

structural_cues: 62:6 joins an exclusive claim of nearness to God with the challenge to desire death if truthful.
62:7 denies that desire because of prior deeds, and 62:8 turns flight into unavoidable encounter and return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared mapped direction branch and the claim-test sequence; I infer that non-guidance exposes a named identity without enacted trajectory. The alternative is a narrower polemic about truthfulness with no lexical feedback into يهدي.

changed_reading.before: They are not guided because they rejected divine signs.
changed_reading.after: They possess a directional identity-label and claim custodial nearness, yet their deeds and evasions show no willingness to travel that claimed course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Friday sequence commands leaving trade for the call, then after prayer permits spreading out and seeking bounty while retaining remembrance; the final scene condemns a dispersal that leaves the speaker standing. Read through the focus's placement branch of ظلم, carrying the trust becomes correct ordering across times, not permanent withdrawal from material life.

activation_trace.role: Putting something outside its proper time or place supplies the focus-side diagnosis of disordered priority.
Entrusted obligation supplies what must be preserved while circumstances and activities change.
Deliberately leaving a thing supplies the required suspension of trade at the appointed moment.
Completion and expiry mark the boundary after which a different activity becomes fitting.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the permitted outward movement after completion.
Seeking a desired thing makes material pursuit legitimate within the ordered sequence.
Keeping something present after possible forgetfulness carries divine remembrance through dispersion.
The breaking apart of a gathered body supplies the formally similar but mistimed dispersal.
Leaving something as it stands identifies what the mistimed movement abandons unfinished.

structural_cues: 62:9 requires trade to stop at the call; 62:10 authorizes dispersion and seeking only after prayer is completed.
62:10 carries remembrance into dispersion, whereas 62:11 depicts dispersion toward trade or amusement that abandons the standing address.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two dispersals with different sequencing and the focus branch for misplacement; I infer that the contrast specifies ظلم as temporal displacement and ح م ل as preserved priority. The live alternative is generic injustice plus an unrelated etiquette of Friday prayer.

changed_reading.before: Not carrying scripture means failing to obey its commands.
changed_reading.after: Not carrying is a failure of placement: market, worship, movement, and remembrance are each legitimate, but the trust is betrayed when one is installed in another's time.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context's command to spread out activates both opening-and-branching and the branch of a written or unfolded book. Against the focus's أسفار, this creates a material reversal: a carried book should be opened and distributed into post-prayer movement while remembrance remains active, not stay bundled as weight.

activation_trace.role: A book that reveals writing supplies the focus object whose latent operation can be unfolded.
Uncovering provides the book's opening motion rather than its inert mass.
A writing or unfolded book lets the command to disperse echo the textual object in the focus.
Opening, spreading, and branching turn textual disclosure into outward circulation.
Active recollection supplies what keeps the opened text present during worldly movement.

structural_cues: 62:10 places dispersion, seeking bounty, and much remembrance in one post-prayer movement.
The same context later distinguishes that commanded spreading from dispersal that abandons the speaker.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies أسفار as revealing books and نشر as both spreading and an unfolded writing; I infer a circulation arrow from textual opening into lived movement. Ordinary spatial dispersion remains the primary contextual sense, so the book echo is secondary but live.

changed_reading.before: The books are dead weight because their carrier does not comprehend them.
changed_reading.after: The books are arrested circulation: what should be uncovered, spread into conduct, and kept present in motion remains closed cargo.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final scene places a standing messenger beside a crowd broken apart by trade, while the focus twice calls its subjects a qawm. The branch range allows a social diagnosis: a people is constituted by what it sustains and makes stand, and here market vitality displaces custodial standing.

activation_trace.role: Qiwam as support and ordering principle makes the collective answerable for what holds its life together.
Guardianship supplies the standing-over function abandoned by the failed carriers.
Bodily standing makes the abandoned speaker the visible remainder of the crowd's failed communal stance.
A market that stands by flourishing supplies the rival form of qiyam activated by adjacent trade.
Profit-seeking identifies the institution whose vitality reorganizes the gathered body's attention.
The gathering's breakup shows the collective ceasing to stand as a custodial body.

structural_cues: 62:11 juxtaposes seeing trade or amusement, dispersing toward it, and leaving the addressee standing.
The focus repeats القوم around denial and non-guidance, inviting the later قائمًا to reactivate the collective root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies qawm, qiyam, market flourishing, trade, and dispersal; I infer that the later tableau revalues what gives a people its qiwam. The alternative is a local scene of distraction with no semantic return to القوم in 62:5.

changed_reading.before: The qawm is simply the group that bears collective blame.
changed_reading.after: The qawm is exposed by its chosen support: it lets the market stand and leaves revelatory stewardship standing alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The form-distant branch inventory for seeing includes the visible appearance of an animal's pregnancy. Activated beside trade, that image sharpens the focus root's own inward pregnancy or fruit branch: bodies visibly redirect toward profitable display while the scriptural load has produced no inwardly ripened sign.

activation_trace.role: Pregnancy and fruit supply the focus-side image of an inward load becoming visibly generative.
External transport supplies the non-generative load against which inward fruition is tested.
The appearance of pregnancy in an animal makes inward carrying something that eventually shows an outcome.
Trade and sought profit supply the visible yield that attracts bodies away from an unmonetized revelatory yield.

structural_cues: 62:11 makes seeing trade or amusement the immediate pivot into dispersal.
The focus already repeats carrying around an animal body, so the context branch's visible animal pregnancy has a concrete anchor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the pregnancy branch under seeing and the internal-load branch under carrying; I infer that visible yield activates a contrast between ripened and merely exterior loads. Ordinary visual perception is the materially stronger reading of رأوا, so this remains exploratory.

changed_reading.before: The books fail to affect their external bearers.
changed_reading.after: The books are an exterior burden with no visible birth or fruit, while immediately profitable appearances successfully redirect the bearers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it shifts the donkey root from the named animal to its adjacent wooden, stone, or structural support branch. It remains anchored in حمار plus the explicit carrying of books and clarifies radical passivity; downstream prose should present it only as a material echo of the literal donkey, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The literal donkey at word 9 is immediately defined by carrying books at words 10-11.

activation_trace.role: A beam, stone, or support on which things rest turns the animal into a shelf-like bearer with no transaction with its load.
Visible external weight supplies what the passive support successfully holds.
Revealing books supply an active function that shelf-like support cannot receive or perform.

changed_reading.before: The donkey is an ignorant animal carrying books.
changed_reading.after: At the material edge of the image, the bearer has become library furniture: structurally adequate for storage and wholly absent from disclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The wild-animal running branch of ك ذ ب is remote from ordinary تكذيب, so the semantic claim must be qualified. It remains anchored by the focus's repeated carrying and the context's purposeful striving and flight; downstream prose should render it as a kinetic undertone of failure to carry through, not as the lexical meaning of denial.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كَذَّبُوا at word 16 follows the three-step carrying sequence and is followed by loss of guidance.

activation_trace.role: An animal that runs a stretch and then stops to look back supplies denial as interrupted forward motion.
Entrusted responsibility gives the interrupted motion a task that should have been carried through.
Purposeful movement toward a goal supplies the positive contrast to motion that breaks off.
Flight supplies misdirected motion that cannot evade its eventual encounter.

changed_reading.before: Denying the signs is a false judgment about their truth.
changed_reading.after: As a contained kinetic echo, denial is also a charge that does not carry through: movement begins, breaks, looks back, and loses its direction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Guidance as a swaying, supported gait is an unusual bodily branch, and its activation through هادوا is form-distant. It remains anchored in the focus's يهدي, repeated burden, and carrying animal; downstream prose should frame it as an embodied analogy for unstable dependence, alongside rather than instead of moral guidance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The closing يهدي at word 21 follows a scene of a burdened animal walking under books.

activation_trace.role: Walking with support and swaying gives guidance an embodied question of stable, self-directed gait.
The heavy visible load supplies what can make a carrier's movement dependent or unstable.
The mapped communal designation reactivates the same supported-gait branch immediately after the focus.

changed_reading.before: God does not grant the rejecting group moral direction.
changed_reading.after: At the bodily edge of the image, they can move under inherited weight yet cannot acquire a steady gait of their own.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Making the simile itself stand is a personifying cross-ayah move, but it is supported by the مثول branch, the example-as-sign branch, and the final standing/dispersal tableau. It should be rendered as rhetorical architecture: the literal speaker stands in 62:11, while the focus's example only figuratively remains erected for later hearers.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَثَل is repeated three times, giving the comparison unusual textual persistence.

activation_trace.role: Erect presence lets the repeatedly struck example remain standing as a textual object.
The example as admonitory sign gives that standing object an ongoing warning function.
The speaker's literal bodily standing supplies the contextual posture reflected back onto the example.
The gathered audience breaking apart makes standing persistence visible against human dispersal.

changed_reading.before: The simile briefly illustrates a past group's failure.
changed_reading.after: The repeatedly erected example remains standing after audiences disperse, continuing to expose any later carrier who repeats the pattern.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The branch of ر ء ي mapped to ر و ي that names leading figures who carry heavy loads is highly form-distant from ordinary seeing. It remains visibly anchored to the focus's entrusted burden and communal guardianship and is activated beside the trade scene; downstream prose should preserve it only as a packet-backed leadership echo, not derive leadership from رأوا directly.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus assigns a burden to a collective and twice names that collective a qawm.

activation_trace.role: Entrusted burden supplies the responsibility that leaders or custodians would be expected to bear.
Guardianship over an affair locates the burden within communal leadership rather than private possession alone.
Leading figures who carry heavy loads provide the surprising explicit bridge from seeing to burden-bearing authority.
Profit-seeking supplies the rival pull under which burden-bearing authority abandons its public charge.

changed_reading.before: The donkey image criticizes undifferentiated bearers of inherited scripture.
changed_reading.after: As a contained leadership echo, it also asks whether those who stand over a community carry its revelatory weight or abandon that charge when profit appears.

strongest_changes: Carrying moved from possession on a back to entrusted fidelity expressed through following, growth, hands, and intentional deeds.
The books became arrested disclosure: material meant to uncover and circulate signs has been reduced to opaque weight.
The Friday sequence revised ظلم into wrong temporal placement, distinguishing commanded worldly movement from movement that abandons the trust.
The repeated qawm became a question of communal qiwam: what a people guards, supports, and chooses to make stand.
summary.what_was_special: The packet sustained several coexisting mechanisms instead of one verdict: legal trust, pedagogy, material disclosure, bodily agency, temporal ordering, and social support. Its split mappings also activated contained but unusually vivid readings of pregnancy becoming visible, guidance as weighted gait, leaders carrying loads, and an example that remains standing after dispersal.
remaining_uncertainties: The pregnancy, weighted-gait, and load-bearing-leader readings are exact branch activations but form-distant; they should remain exploratory rather than govern the plain syntax.
The market-standing/qiwam model may be deliberate contextual resonance or an abductive social mechanism generated by adjacency.
The book-as-dispersal model depends on treating نشر's writing branch as feedback into أسفار; ordinary spatial dispersion remains fully live alongside it.
